caseNameFull: UNITED STATES v. Thomas R. NOLAND, Trustee for Debtor First Truck Lines, Inc.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted. The case is set for oral argument in tandem with No. 95-325, United States v. Reorganized CF & I Fabricators of Utah, Inc., et al.
